concepts.def: Exposing essential features while hiding unnecessary detail.
Unified Modeling Language — standard diagrams for OO design.
A UML diagram of classes, attributes, methods and relationships.
A UML relationship where one class uses another.
A 'has-a' UML relationship where parts can exist independently.
A stronger 'has-a' where parts cannot exist without the whole.

walkthroughs.body_html: Abstraction picks out what matters for the problem. A Car class for a racing game cares about speed and grip; a Car class for an insurance app cares about VIN and policy. Same noun, different abstraction.
A UML class diagram shows boxes with class name, attributes and methods, joined by arrows. Inheritance uses a hollow triangle; association uses a plain arrow.
Aggregation: a Library has Books, but the books survive if the library closes. Composition: a House has Rooms — destroy the house and the rooms go with it.
